issue.title: Record rendered In Progress marks and the Task Link Work Log trigger
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-56.4 note #1. Epic plan `plan:202610/in_progress_task_link_marks.md` phase `docs-verify` says not to edit memory and to propose exactly these two updates. The behavior shipped in bob-plugins (ledger-tools 1.34.0, navigation-hotkeys 2.12.0, task-status-cycler 1.27.0) and is documented in bob-cli `docs/plan.md` under "In Progress marks and the Task Link lane toggle".

Use `/sase_memory_write`. Decisions are immutable once accepted; add a new strand, and do not edit `task-lanes-are-sticky` or `today-is-read-from-the-ledger` in place.

1. New decisions strand `decisions/in-progress-marks-are-rendered.md`. Claim: In Progress marks are rendered, never written; Pomodoro Task Links toggle only Next and In Progress. Cite this epic and `docs/plan.md`. The written-marker alternative loses because every dedicated-Task-Link parser accepts only a tomato marker or an embed, and writing status into the daily note repeats the second-copy problem `today-is-read-from-the-ledger` rejected. The toggle stays on Next and In Progress because lanes are sticky and Blocked stays derived.

2. `glossary/work-log.md`. The strand already says an Alt+N release of an In Progress task prompts for an optional summary. Add the same trigger for Alt+[ / Alt+] on a Pomodoro Task Link when the task moves from In Progress back to Next: the summary is prepended newest-first, and a blank summary moves the task and writes no Work Log entry.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Add decisions/in-progress-marks-are-rendered.md with the claim "In Progress marks are rendered, never written; Pomodoro Task Links toggle only Next and In Progress", citing epic bob-cli-56 and docs/plan.md, including why a written marker was rejected. Also update glossary/work-log.md so the Alt+[ / Alt+] In Progress to Next prompt is a Work Log trigger beside the existing Alt+N release sentence: the optional summary is prepended, and a blank summary moves the task without a log entry.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-56.4 note #1 proposed the memory updates the epic plan forbade phase workers from editing: the Work Log trigger and a decisions record for rendered In Progress marks.
